identificationModule.briefTitle: Vitamin D3 for Aromatase Inhibitor Induced Arthralgias
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Trial to Evaluate the Benefit of High Dose Vitamin D3 on Aromatase Inhibitor Letrozole-Associated Musculoskeletal Symptoms and Fatigue (The VITAL Trial).

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The primary purpose is to determine if high dose vitamin D3 reduces the incidence of musculoskeletal symptoms associated with the aromatase inhibitor letrozole in women with early stage breast cancer and low serum vitamin D levels.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The primary hypothesis is that high dose vitamin D3 plus standard dose vitamin D3 prevents the worsening of musculoskeletal symptoms when compared to a standard dose vitamin D3 treatment. This protocol will examine the relationship between vitamin D levels (25-hydroxyvitamin D) and various quality of life measures in women being treated with letrozole as standard care for early stage breast cancer. All subjects received letrozole and a standard dose of vitamin D3 (600 IU daily). Randomization was between high dose vitamin D3 (30,000 IU once per week) vs. a blinded, matched placebo,

armGroups.label: High Dose Vitamin D
armGroups.description: High Dose Vitamin D3 capsule (3 x 10,000 IU capsules weekly). All subjects also received standard dose vitamin D3 (600 IU daily) and letrozole (2.5 mg daily).
interventionNames: Dietary Supplement: High Dose Vitamin D
Dietary Supplement: Standard Dose Vitamin D3

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Placebo matched for High Dose Vitamin D3 capsules. All subjects also received standard dose vitamin D3 (600 IU daily) and letrozole (2.5 mg daily).
interventionNames: Dietary Supplement: Standard Dose Vitamin D3

interventions.name: High Dose Vitamin D
interventions.description: High Dose Vitamin D3 (3 capsules of 10,000 IU) weekly for 24 weeks.

interventions.name: Standard Dose Vitamin D3
interventions.description: Standard Dose Vitamin D3 (600 IU of vitamin D3 daily)

interventions.name: Letrozole 2.5mg
interventions.description: All subjects received letrozole as standard of care.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of Participants With Worsening of Musculoskeletal Symptoms (MS)
primaryOutcomes.description: Worsening of Musculoskeletal Symptoms (MS) is defined as any one of the following three events: (a) an increase by at least 0.25 in the Health Assessment Questionnaire II (HAQ II, a measure of disability from joint pain) score, (b) an increase in patient reported severity of joint and/or muscle pain, or (c) discontinuation from trial prior to 24 weeks specifically because of problems with musculoskeletal symptoms.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Post-menopausal women newly diagnosed with early stage breast cancer, who would be treated with an aromatase inhibitor
* Serum 25OHD levels \< 40 ng/ml

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe or debilitating musculoskeletal pain
* Known metastatic disease
* History of renal stones
* History of hypercalcemia or hyperthyroidism
* Currently receiving adjuvant or neoadjuvant chemotherapy
* Currently receiving other investigational agents
